About.title: About SecretSpots
About.intro: SecretSpots is a local guide to hidden treasures — waterfalls, viewpoints, hidden cafes, and forgotten corners you won't find on a typical map, shared by the people who actually found them.
About.step1Description: Browse spots shared by real explorers near you, or search for something specific.
About.step2Description: Visit a spot and check in with a proof photo to confirm you were really there.
About.step3Description: Every check-in earns you crystals — a small reward for exploring the real world.
About.missionBody: Search engines are great at finding what everyone already knows about. SecretSpots is for everything else — the places worth a detour that only get passed around by word of mouth. No algorithm curates this list; the community does.
